newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain-Corn values rise, soy, wheat steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain-Corn values rise, soy, wheat steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn basis values rose in nearby positions, while soybean and winter wheat values were mostly unchanged, grain dealers said.
Dealers said corn was needed to fill vessels scheduled to arrive in coming weeks at the U.S. Gulf.

In export news, Taiwan was scheduled to tender late Thursday for 54,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans for March 21-April 19 shipment. Some grain exporters said Lebanon may tender next week for 35,000 tonnes of optional-origin hard red winter wheat for last-half March shipment.
